title: Medical Bill Refusals: Bordenaro on Costs and Consequences
description:
Medical bill refusals are the focus of this recap of Michael Bordenaro's video, “Don't Pay Your Medical Bills: A Dangerous Financial Trend.” We cover his claims about collections, a $1,000 ER bill, online backlash and insurance gaps, followed by his suggestions for reviewing charges, negotiating discounts and requesting assistance—and his warnings about nonpayment. Next are his arguments about persistent inflation, lagging raises, political spending and rising bond yields affecting housing and stocks. Figures and forecasts are presented as his claims, not independently verified current news.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#MichaelBordenaro #MichaelBordenaromedicalbills #DontPayYourMedicalBills #medicalbillcollections #hospitalbillfinancialassistance
